scope: Li Zuyi RK/PC upper-computer final field acceptance evidence

statusLegend.local_ready: Local draft or automated evidence exists and must be rechecked on site.
statusLegend.external_required: Real hardware, model, external platform, RK, production, or industrial-environment evidence is required.
statusLegend.signature_required: Customer, project owner, or responsible-role signature is required.
statusLegend.draft_only: Only draft or illustrative material exists; it cannot prove final acceptance.

globalCaveats: This checklist does not mark the PRD complete.
AI-generated training images are not real hardware, real HMI, or signature evidence.
The silent MP4 training draft is not real operation screen recording or narrated final training video.
Final PRD acceptance still requires hardware, algorithm, external platform, production security/performance, and user signature evidence.

items.title: Local draft delivery package
requiredEvidence: Copy the package to a field date directory
Record version, environment, deployment address, and responsible people

items.title: Training PPTX draft
requiredEvidence: Replace draft screenshots or visual placeholders with final deployment screenshots where required
Keep AI-generated image caveats visible in supporting documentation
items.finalAction: Archive final-site PPTX in the training evidence directory.

items.title: Silent MP4 training draft
requiredEvidence: Avoid showing secrets, private keys, real passwords, or API keys
items.finalAction: Archive final narrated or subtitled MP4.

items.title: UAT operation script
requiredEvidence: Attach screenshots, logs, exports, and issue IDs
Fill pass/fail/blocked/not-applicable result for every item

items.title: STM32 Modbus RTU hardware integration
requiredEvidence: Final register map with address, unit, and scale
Real sensor and actuator read/write logs
items.finalAction: Update Modbus register map and PRD gap matrix.

items.title: Hardware closed-loop control
requiredEvidence: Heating, stirring, pressure, shaking, start/stop, emergency stop, manual lock, pause/resume action records
Audit event IDs for control commands
items.finalAction: Attach closed-loop evidence to UAT-06 and UAT-15.

items.title: Modbus TCP external tool acceptance
requiredEvidence: Modbus Poll or Modbus Slave screenshots

items.title: MQTT external broker acceptance
requiredEvidence: MQTT.fx or mosquitto task publish logs
items.finalAction: Attach broker evidence to third-party acceptance report.

items.title: AINAS real platform acceptance
requiredEvidence: Real AINAS task creation screenshot or API log
Safety rejection record for unsafe task if applicable

items.title: Qwen/GGUF/LoRA/RK model evidence
items.finalAction: Update local_ai readiness status and AI acceptance evidence.

items.title: Production TLS and key lifecycle
items.finalAction: Attach evidence to production operations and security docs.

items.title: Browser and mobile real-device acceptance
localEvidenceAlreadyAvailable: Playwright Firefox strict browser matrix passed on 2026-06-07 with 14 route/language checks
items.finalAction: Attach evidence to visual evidence index and UAT-14.
